Themes and addons

Every lookup resolves through a cascade: your own files, then any addons you list in site.json, then the theme.

sections/hero.liqx        ← yours always wins
addons/blog-pack/sections/hero.liqx
themes/basic/sections/hero.liqx

So you can override one section of a theme by dropping a file of the same name into your own sections/, with nothing to fork and nothing to eject from.

When it is not obvious which file won:

pillar why sections/hero.liqx
# wins     site      ./sections/hero.liqx
# shadowed addon:blog-pack  ./addons/blog-pack/sections/hero.liqx

An addon is inert data — templates, assets, schemas, locales, no PHP — so installing one is copying a directory.
